summary: Schedule becomes permanently deadlocked when a scheduled workflow with retry policy exhausts retries and the same Workflow ID is manually executed, causing the scheduler to block in infinite retries when attempting to refresh the previous action.
userImpact: Schedules become permanently blocked and stop launching scheduled actions, requiring server restart to recover.
rootCause: When the scheduler follows a previous execution chain by FirstExecutionRunId after detecting a newer independent chain exists, PollMutableState returns status from the terminal retry chain combined with a close event from a different run. The code expects WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED event attributes but receives WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_CONTINUED_AS_NEW event, triggering errNoAttrs with automatic retry enabled, causing infinite blocking.
proposedFix: Ensure PollMutableState status and fetched close event refer to the same terminal execution when following FirstExecutionRunId. Make errNoAttrs non-retryable or prevent WatchWorkflow from permanently blocking Schedule processing.
keyQuote: WatchWorkflow: last event did not have correct attrs
